decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's resources while applying pressure with aggressive creatures and efficient spells. By utilizing disruptive cards like Wasteland, Deathrite Shaman, and Collector Ouphe, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan and gain an advantage. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Tarmogoyf and Leovold, Emissary of Trest to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. With a strong mix of disruption, card advantage, and threats, this deck aims to control the game while putting the opponent on the back foot.

The main concept of this Vintage 1 vs 1 Dredge combo deck revolves around rapidly filling your graveyard with cards like Stinkweed Imp, Golgari Thug, and Shambling Shell to trigger powerful graveyard-based effects such as Silversmote Ghoul and Prized Amalgam. By using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to quickly stock the graveyard, as well as cards like Narcomoeba and Hollow One to create additional threats, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells while leveraging cards like Creeping Chill for additional value.

The deck focuses on quickly and efficiently assembling the combo of Hermit Druid and Thassa's Oracle to win the game. It utilizes a variety of fast mana sources and card selection spells to enable the combo as early as possible, while also including disruptive elements like Force of Will and Cabal Therapy to protect the combo from opposing interaction. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for extra value and recursion, making the deck even more resilient in the face of disruption.

This deck focuses on using powerful spells and disruptive creatures to control the board and tempo of the game. It utilizes fast mana acceleration and card advantage through tutors and draw spells to establish an early lead. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while quickly developing a threatening board presence. Using counterspells and removal spells, the deck aims to protect its key threats and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a win before they can stabilize. The deck's win condition involves efficient beatdown strategies and combo pieces to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game. It includes various tutors and draw spells to find the combo pieces quickly, along with disruption cards like Force of Will to protect the combo. The deck also features some mana acceleration in the form of Dark Ritual and Moxen to speed up the game. The goal is to set up a winning pile with Doomsday, using various cards to manipulate the library and win the game with Thassa's Oracle's ability.

The deck aims to assemble a powerful combo using cards like Grim Monolith, Tinker, Trinisphere, Sensei's Divining Top, and Phyrexian Metamorph. It also includes various fast mana sources like Moxen and Mishra's Workshop to ramp up quickly. The primary win condition is to use Paradoxical Outcome to generate card advantage and re-play powerful artifacts like Coveted Jewel. The deck also features control elements like Force of Will and Karn, the Great Creator to protect the combo. In summary, the deck is focused on comboing off quickly with powerful artifacts.

The deck focuses on using artifacts and control elements to manipulate the game and generate advantages while restricting the opponent's resources. It aims to create a strong board presence through the use of cards like Voltaic Key, Mana Crypt, and Mox Opal, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Force of Will and Balance. The inclusion of Goblin Engineer and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade adds versatility and additional disruption to the deck, allowing for a flexible and adaptive playstyle. The deck's ultimate goal is to outmaneuver and outlast the opponent to secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly playing powerful threats such as Sphinx of the Steel Wind and Narset, Parter of Veils while controlling the game with counterspells like Force of Will and Mindbreak Trap. Lavinia, Azorius Renegade disrupts opponents' mana bases, while cards like Tinker and Time Vault provide alternative win conditions. The deck aims to outpace opponents with efficient plays and disruption, utilizing powerful artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxen to accelerate its game plan. The tempo strategy seeks to neutralize threats and control the game until it can establish a dominant board presence and win the game.

The main idea of this deck is to generate mana quickly with cards like Grim Monolith and Mishra's Workshop to power out powerful artifact threats like Golos, Tireless Pilgrim and Karn, the Great Creator. The deck also aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Trinisphere and Sphere of Resistance while also using cards like Manifold Key and The One Ring to buff up its threats and close out the game quickly with big swings. The deck benefits from a mix of mana acceleration, disruption, and powerful threats to overwhelm opponents.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful control elements such as counterspells, card selection, and tutoring to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building up its own resources. The deck also includes powerful win conditions like Tinker into Time Vault or Bolas's Citadel to close out the game quickly. By combining card advantage, disruptive elements, and strong finishers, the deck aims to outmaneuver and overpower the opponent in the late game, while protecting its own key pieces with counterspells and removal spells.

This deck focuses on efficiently using low-cost and high-value spells to control the game while applying pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures. By leveraging powerful cards like Time Walk, Ancestral Recall, and Lurrus of the Dream-Den, it aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent in the early game. With a mix of disruptive spells, card draw, and aggressive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dreadhorde Arcanist, this deck seeks to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to generate a large amount of mana and draw cards, ultimately leading to playing and activating Coveted Jewel multiple times to gain card advantage and potentially win the game. The deck utilizes cards like Mishra's Workshop, Grim Monolith, and Paradoxical Outcome to accelerate its game plan, while also including disruptive elements like Force of Will and Trinisphere to protect the combo. Karn, the Great Creator and Manifold Key are included to help assemble the combo pieces and enable multiple activations of Coveted Jewel.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 deck focuses on using Bazaar of Baghdad to quickly fill the graveyard with threats like Vengevine and Hollow One, while using cards like Noxious Revival and Squee, Goblin Nabob to recur creatures. The deck also includes disruption with counterspells like Force of Will and Mindbreak Trap, as well as removal with Force of Vigor. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption, controlling the game and closing it out quickly.

This deck focuses on utilizing disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chancellor of the Annex to slow down the opponent while also ramping with Ancient Tomb and Chrome Mox. The goal is to control the game with hatebears, disruptive elements, and mana denial through cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine, leading to a win either through the beatdown plan with creatures like Archon of Emeria or through combo finish with Emeria's Call. With a mix of aggression and disruption, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Bazaar of Baghdad to quickly fill up the graveyard and trigger powerful graveyard-based effects like Vengevine and Hollow One. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures while disrupting their game plan with countermagic and removal spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation. The deck also includes cards like Noxious Revival and Squee, Goblin Nabob to recur key cards from the graveyard, maintaining pressure on the opponent throughout the game.

The deck revolves around utilizing powerful artifacts like Coveted Jewel, Grim Monolith, and Paradoxical Outcome to generate mana, draw cards, and eventually assemble a game-ending combo with cards like Tinker, Time Vault, and Manifold Key. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Trinisphere to protect the combo and disrupt opponents. The artifact synergy and mana acceleration provided by Mishra's Workshop, Tolarian Academy, and Ancient Tomb allow for explosive plays and high-powered turns, while also leveraging the powerful artifact support cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Mystic Forge for additional value and utility.
